title: Create src/tui/themes/colors.ts
description: Create the Rocket color palette constants used across all TUI components. Export named color constants for consistent visual styling.
acceptanceCriteria: At least brand and success colors are used in other components

steps.details: Create the directory src/tui/themes/ and the colors.ts file.

Export: export const colors = { brand: 'cyan', timing: 'yellow', success: 'green', error: 'red', highlight: 'magenta', dim: 'gray' } as const. Also export individual named exports for convenience: export const { brand, timing, success, error, highlight, dim } = colors.

technicalNotes: Ink Text component accepts color as a string prop matching chalk color names: 'cyan', 'yellow', 'green', etc.
Using a centralized colors file ensures consistent branding across all components
